headline: Neutral Ground Shifts as Fronts Stir
war_summary: Since the last edition, Weathered Expanse has swung toward Warden control: seven of its nine strategic bases are now Warden-held and two neutral, with no Colonial-held bases, against the previous three Warden, one Colonial and five neutral. Its 48 event rows in 24 hours include 16 in the latest six, though none in the latest two. Nevish Line has also shifted, from six Colonial and two Warden bases to five Colonial, one Warden and two neutral; nine event rows came in the latest two hours, amid 52 for the day. Linn’s Mercy now stands at eight Colonial, two Warden and one neutral, a one-base shift toward Colonial control, with two recent events and 36 in the day. Callahan’s Passage remains wholly Warden-held; its recent turnover has paused, with no event in the latest two hours. Marban Hollow and Mooring County retain their divided and Warden-heavy balances respectively, and both are quiet in that same window. A smaller fresh disturbance appears at Briar in Stlican Shelf, where three event rows include neutralization and a Warden capture; the region remains eight Colonial to one Warden. The war is unresolved; 34 victory towns are required.
